summary: G-III Apparel Group filed an 8-K on May 14, 2026, announcing its entry into a Unit Purchase Agreement to acquire the Marc Jacobs business from LVMH. The structure involves G-III and WHP Global forming a joint venture (IPCo) to buy Marc Jacobs Holdings, with G-III investing approximately $500 million from cash on hand and its revolving credit facility. Post-closing, G-III will operate the Marc Jacobs business under a license from IPCo, which retains the intellectual property. The closing is subject to customary conditions, including antitrust approvals, with an outside date of six months. Watch for regulatory clearance and the joint venture's operational mechanics.
